Markets.title: RBI easing drives Indian companies’ $7.70 billion overseas borrowing
Markets.summary: Indian companies filed $7.70 billion in overseas borrowing proposals in July, marking a 27% increase from the previous month. This surge follows the Reserve Bank of India's decision earlier this year to ease its borrowing framework by raising caps and removing cost ceilings.

Markets.title: Prasol Chemicals mobilises Rs 150 cr from anchor investors ahead of IPO
Markets.summary: Prasol Chemicals raised Rs 150 crore from anchor investors by pricing its shares at Rs 676 each ahead of its September 8 IPO. The investors participating in this share allocation included Tata Mutual Fund, Kotak Mahindra Mutual Fund, and Aditya Birla Sun Life Insurance.

Markets.title: Taiwan's Wistron raises $1.5 billion in global share sale to fund raw material purchases
Markets.summary: Nvidia supplier Wistron is raising $1.47 billion through a global share sale to fund foreign currency raw material purchases. The Taiwanese company is also using the funds to expand production, including a new $700 million AI systems plant in Texas.

Markets.title: European shares subdued as surging crude sharpens focus on ECB rate path
Markets.summary: European stock markets closed largely flat as rising oil prices and geopolitical tensions heightened inflation worries. At the same time, investors increased their bets on further interest rate hikes by the European Central Bank.

Markets.title: Copper prices scale fresh record high as focus turns to tight supplies outside US
Markets.summary: Copper prices reached a record high of $14,533 per metric ton due to supply shortages outside the United States and a weaker dollar. This increase highlights a growing divergence, driven by falling inventories in Shanghai and strong inventories in the US.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Tuesday
Markets.summary: Rising oil prices and US-Iran tensions caused the Sensex and Nifty to extend their four-week losing streak. Although supply disruptions and stretched valuations pose downside risks, earnings improvements and selective buying supported small-cap and mid-cap stocks.

Geo-Political.title: Palestinian parents fear for children's lives at school as settler attacks grow
Geo-Political.summary: Palestinian parents in the occupied West Bank fear for their children's safety as settler attacks increase. A headteacher has installed new barbed wire fencing after three pupils were killed this year.

Geo-Political.title: Germany's far-right AfD says 'democracy demands' parties work with them after state election win
Geo-Political.summary: After winning a state election, Germany's far-right AfD party stated that democracy requires other political parties to cooperate with them. The party fell three seats short of a majority and is currently attempting to form a government.

Geo-Political.title: Thousands turn out in Serbia for funeral of  'Butcher of Bosnia' Ratko Mladić
Geo-Political.summary: Thousands of people attended the funeral in Serbia for Ratko Mladić, the convicted war criminal known as the "Butcher of Bosnia." Mladić was serving a life sentence for genocide committed during the Bosnian war of the 1990s.

Geo-Political.title: Israeli strikes in southern Lebanese village kill 12
Geo-Political.summary: Israeli strikes in a southern Lebanese village killed 12 people. Lebanon stated that this escalation threatens the US-brokered ceasefire aimed at ending the conflict between Israel and Hezbollah.

Geo-Political.title: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
Geo-Political.summary: Grindr has agreed to pay £26 million to settle a lawsuit alleging it breached UK privacy laws. The claim stated the dating app shared users' sensitive data, including HIV status, with third-party companies.

Geo-Political.title: Nepal observes national day of mourning for victims of flash flood disaster
Geo-Political.summary: Nepal observed a national day of mourning for the victims of a recent flash flood disaster. Flags flew at half-mast to mark the final day of the traditional Hindu mourning period.

Data & Insights.title: CII business confidence rebounds in Q2 on improving demand, hiring and investment outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The CII Business Confidence Index rose to 66 in Q2FY27. This rebound was driven by stronger domestic demand, higher capacity utilization, and easing cost pressures.

Data & Insights.title: Tech glitch or weak demand? Conflicting claims emerge as RBI launches another liquidity withdrawal op; check details
Data & Insights.summary: The Reserve Bank of India is holding a 5 trillion rupee Variable Rate Reverse Repo auction on September 7. This follows a previous longer-tenor auction that received only 2.59 trillion rupees in offers, raising questions about market demand and technical issues.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting postponed to 7 October from 12 September
Data & Insights.summary: The GST Council meeting has been postponed from 12 September to 7 October. Ahead of this meeting, preparatory sessions for government officers are scheduled for 5 and 6 October.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer | Why the era of cheap money is ending
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's Ratings reports that a shift toward higher interest rates is driving differentiated repricing across financial assets. This change marks the end of the era of cheap money and the beginning of a new macroeconomic regime.

Data & Insights.title: GST Council meeting rescheduled: BRICS Summit clash pushes 57th meet to October 7
Data & Insights.summary: The 57th GST Council meeting has been rescheduled from September 12 to October 7 due to a scheduling conflict with the BRICS Summit in New Delhi. The upcoming meeting is expected to address pending tax issues such as input tax credits, corporate guarantees, and rate rationalisation.

Data & Insights.title: Smaller economy, PPI inclusion: Why India’s GDP is facing fresh scrutiny
Data & Insights.summary: India's new gross domestic product methodology resolves past statistical problems, but downward nominal revisions create credibility concerns. Additionally, the unexpected inclusion of the Producer Price Index has sparked fresh scrutiny over the country's economic data.

India.title: Gift Amid Grief: Delhi Building Collapse Victim's Family Donates His Corneas
India.summary: Following the tragic death of their son Arpit in a Delhi building collapse, his grieving family donated his corneas. This selfless decision ensures that Arpit's gift will help others regain their sight.

India.title: Baba Ramdev's Aide Balkrishna Acquitted In 15-Year Old Forged Documents Case
India.summary: A CBI court in India has acquitted Baba Ramdev's aide, Balkrishna, in a 15-year-old forged documents case. Co-accused Naresh Chandra Dwivedi, who was charged with providing the forged papers, was also acquitted by the court.

India.title: Ground Report | Sunlight Is A Luxury In Delhi Students' Hub Where Building Collapse Killed 7
India.summary: A building collapse in Delhi's Satya Niketan killed seven people due to failing civic infrastructure and overcrowded living conditions. Landlord greed and an influx of tenants have caused the area's development to crumble under the strain.

India.title: Delhi Tragedy: Building Owner Retired From Air Force, Runs Shop In Gurugram
India.summary: A 50-year-old building owned by a retired Air Force personnel was converted into a paying-guest facility near Delhi University. The Gupta family had previously repaired the structure to accommodate students in the area.

India.title: Key Officer, 4 Civic Body Officials Suspended After Delhi Tragedy Kills 7
India.summary: Following a tragedy in Delhi's Satya Niketan area that killed seven people, authorities suspended a key officer and four civic body officials. The densely populated neighborhood primarily houses hundreds of university students in crowded accommodations.

India.title: Dry Day, Grants Cut: Suvendu Adhikari's Big-Ticket Changes For Durga Puja
India.summary: BJP leader Suvendu Adhikari promised to stop government grants for Durga Puja if he becomes Chief Minister. He also stated that he would declare the festival a dry day.

General.title: Minister condemns disorder at Portsmouth anti-migrant protest after police officers hurt
General.summary: Minister Sarah Jones condemned violent disorder at an anti-migrant protest in Portsmouth that resulted in injuries to police officers. She described the unrest, sparked by the arrival of 120 migrants in a single dinghy, as intimidating and thuggish.

General.title: What we know about anti-migrant protests and organiser Danny Thomas
General.summary: Anti-migrant protests occurred in Dover and Portsmouth over the weekend involving small boat demonstrations. UK correspondent Daniel Sandford investigated these events and their connection to organiser Danny Thomas.

General.title: King makes clear Harry and Meghan remain non-working royals
General.summary: King Charles has clarified that Prince Harry and Meghan Markle will not return as working members of the royal family. Palace sources confirmed that official notices outlining this decision have been sent to the government, military, Lord Lieutenants, and Harry's team.

General.title: Faisal Islam: Chancellor's attempts to boost vibes may limit tax rises
General.summary: The new government leadership is attempting to boost public and economic confidence. This focus on maintaining market optimism may limit the need for future tax increases.

General.title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs over next two years
General.summary: Jaguar Land Rover will cut 4,000 jobs over the next two years. The automaker is struggling with Chinese competition, US tariffs, and the transition to electric vehicles.
